    def permute(self, nums):
        # DPS with swapping
        res = []
        if len(nums) == 0:
            return res
        self.get_permute(res, nums, 0)
        return res

    def get_permute(self, res, nums, index):
        if index == len(nums):
            res.append(list(nums))
            return
        for i in range(index, len(nums)):
            nums[i], nums[index] = nums[index], nums[i]
            # s(n) = 1 + s(n-1)
            self.get_permute(res, nums, index + 1)
            nums[i], nums[index] = nums[index], nums[i]

# Time:  O(n)
# Space: O(1)

class Solution(object):
    def findMaxAverage(self, nums, k):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: float
        """
        result = total = sum(nums[:k])
        for i in range(k, len(nums)):
            total += nums[i] - nums[i-k]
            result = max(result, total)
        return float(result) / k
source_reason: Combined incoming/outgoing update maintains the same fixed-width sum; only xrange is ported.
